title: FairJudge: MLLM Judging for Social-Attributes and Prompt–Image Alignment
benchmark_measurement: Accuracy of predicting religious affiliation from visual cues (e.g., symbols, context) in images, with a focus on evidence-based reasoning and calibrated abstention when evidence is insufficient.
findings: MLLM judges using the FairJudge protocol significantly outperform CLIP-based methods in identifying religious attributes from images. This improvement is attributed to the protocol's emphasis on evidence-based reasoning for visual symbols and context, and its ability to abstain when cues are insufficient, which is crucial for attributes not visible on the face.
